246.description_text: Introducing Mr. HYDE® Infinite Fully Dosed Pre-Workout- our most powerful HYDE formula yet. Packed with 10g Citrulline, 6.4g Beta-Alanine, 5g Creatine, and 380mg caffeine from a triple-source blend, it delivers infinite energy, infinite strength, and infinite focus to help you dominate every workout. This is HYDE, elevated to the Infinite level. † Introducing Mr. HYDE® Infinite Fully Dosed Pre-Workout- our most powerful HYDE formula yet. Packed with 10g Citrulline, 6.4g Beta-Alanine, 5g Creatine, and 380mg caffeine from a triple-source blend, it delivers infinite energy, infinite strength, and infinite focus to help you dominate every workout. This is HYDE, elevated to the Infinite level. † VIEW SUPPLEMENT FACTS VIEW SUPPLEMENT FACTS VIEW SUPPLEMENT FACTS What's In Mr. HYDE Infinite? Overview Introducing Mr. HYDE® Infinite Fully Dosed Pre-Workout- our most powerful HYDE formula yet. Packed with 10g Citrulline, 6.4g Beta-Alanine, 5g Creatine, and 380mg caffeine from a triple-source blend, it delivers infinite energy, infinite strength, and infinite focus to help you dominate every workout. This is HYDE, elevated to the Infinite level. † L-Citrulline L-Citrulline is an amino acid that boosts nitric oxide production- the molecule responsible for dilating blood vessels. This process increases blood flow, which helps to improve nutrient transport and supply the muscles with fresh blood and oxygen during exercise, improving endurance, pumps and recovery. † Creatine Monohydrate Creatine monohydrate is one of the most researched and studied supplements in the field of sports nutrition. Creatine is stored in muscles and used to rapidly regenerate ATP during short, intense bursts of activity. This allows for increased energy availability and performance during activities that require quick, powerful movements.† Beta-Alanine Beta-Alanine helps to regulate the lactic acid build up in the muscle to reduce exercise fatigue. This means you can push harder and hit more reps in the gym. Beta-Alanine is also responsible for the tingle sensation that most users experience when taking a pre-workout. But don’t worry, it goes away after a few minutes.† L-Tyrosine L-Tyrosine serves as a precursor to several important neurotransmitters, including dopamine and adrenaline- basically the stuff that keeps you feeling focused and in a good mood. It helps to reduce stress, sharpen your mind and keep you alert so you maximize your workouts.† Betaine Anhydrous Betaine Anhydrous helps maintain fluid balance in the cells by pulling water into your muscles, giving you better pumps. This helps to boost performance by improving cellular hydration, endurance and strength.† Choline Bitartrate Choline Bitartrate helps to improve the communication between your nervous system and your muscles, so you perform better and more efficiently. It’s the brain fuel you need to stay focused, improve cognitive function and muscle contraction during exercise.† EndoFlo EndoFlo is a cutting-edge ingredient that’s all about enhancing blood flow and nutrient delivery during your workouts. EndoFlo is designed to support the body's natural production of nitric oxide, which is key for dilating blood vessels and improving circulation. When your blood vessels open up, more oxygen and nutrients can reach your muscles, leading to better performance and those satisfying pumps we all chase in the gym. This not only helps improve endurance by reducing fatigue but also aids in faster recovery between sets.† NeuroRush NeuroRush™ utilizes Coffea Arabica Extract to boost cognitive function, mood, and vitality, while also supporting neuroprotection. It is rich in chlorogenic acids, also known as CGA, and can enhance reaction time, alertness, and memory, making it a reliable choice for optimizing brain health and function. † Dynamine® Dynamine™ is a rapid-onset alkaloid typically used in combination with caffeine and TeaCrine®. Caffeine, Dynamine™ and TeaCrine® help with cognitive performance during mentally demanding tasks. So whether you’re a “spreadsheet athlete,” gaming or working out, Dynamine™ is ideal in products ranging from pre workouts and energy drinks to cognitive optimization. Infinergy Infinergy is a unique form of Di-Caffeine Malate that delivers all the benefits of caffeine while providing a steady, sustained energy boost without the quick spike and crash typical of regular caffeine. By combining the established properties of caffeine with malic acid, Infinergy offers a multi-dimensional advantage that optimizes your energy levels and stimulates thermogenesis, helping your body burn more calories. Plus, it enhances mental focus, keeping you sharp and engaged throughout your workouts. With Infinergy, you’re set for a productive training session that supports both physical performance and cognitive clarity!† ProSupps Brand Promise Our dedication to quality and integrity means that we never cut corners, and we always put your health and performance FIRST. Our products contain zero fillers, zero banned substances and zero FD&C dyes. Every ProSupps product goes through rigorous third-party testing for purity, efficacy and transparency. EVERY BATCH. EVERY TIME. Push your limits and stay hydrated with cutting-edge science designed for those who strive for greatness. † Aquamin S Aquamin® S is a natural mineral complex made from red algae, packed with calcium, magnesium, and other important trace minerals. It’s commonly used in supplements to help support strong bones, healthy joints, and overall mineral balance in your body. The calcium in Aquamin® S is easy for your body to absorb, so it’s really effective for supporting bone health. It’s also believed to help with inflammation, which is why it’s often included in joint health products. Since it's plant-based and comes from the sea, Aquamin® S is a great, natural way to give your body the minerals it needs.† CocOganic Coc0ganic® is organic coconut water powder. It’s made from freeze-dried coconut water and is used to provide natural hydration, electrolytes, and other nutrients. Because coconut water is naturally rich in potassium, magnesium, and sodium, Coc0ganic® helps support hydration and replenish electrolytes lost during intense exercise or physical activity. This helps to enhance performance, reduce muscle cramping, and maintain energy levels.† EAAs Essential Amino Acids (EAAs) are the building blocks of protein that your body cannot produce on its own, meaning they must come from your diet or supplements. Unlike non-essential amino acids that your body can synthesize, EAAs are vital for various physiological processes, including muscle growth, repair, and recovery. There are 9 total EAAS, 3 are branch-chained or BCAAs while the other 6, lysine, phenylalanine, threonine, methionine, histidine, and tryptophan are not. These essential amino acids (EAAs) work together to promote muscle growth and recovery while supporting overall health. They aid in protein synthesis, help repair muscle tissue after exercise, and improve endurance during workouts. Beyond muscle health, they contribute to key functions such as boosting immune support, enhancing mental clarity and focus, promoting healthy skin and joints, and supporting mood and sleep. † BCAAs (Brand Chain Amino Acids) BCAAs, or Branched-Chain Amino Acids, are a group of three essential amino acids: leucine, isoleucine, and valine. These amino acids are called "essential" because your body can’t produce them on its own, so you need to get them from food or supplements. BCAAs play a huge role in muscle recovery and growth. Leucine is the powerhouse that kicks off protein synthesis, which is basically the process your muscles go through to repair and grow after a workout. Isoleucine helps with energy production during exercise and assists in muscle repair, while valine helps prevent muscle breakdown. Together, they help reduce muscle soreness, improve endurance, and support muscle recovery, especially after intense workouts. † Electrolytes Electrolytes help balance fluids, support muscles, and improve performance during intense exercise.† Magnesium Magnesium is a mineral that your body needs to stay healthy, and it plays a big role in a variety of important functions. First off, it helps keep your muscles and nerves working properly. It’s involved in muscle contractions, so if you're low in magnesium, you might experience cramps or muscle weakness. Magnesium also supports your heart by helping regulate your heartbeat and blood pressure. It’s crucial for bone health too, as it helps your body use calcium effectively. On top of that, magnesium is involved in energy production and helps turn the food you eat into energy for your body to use.† Potassium Potassium is a vital mineral that plays a key role in keeping your body functioning at its best, especially during workouts. Potassium is essential for maintaining proper fluid balance and electrolyte levels, which is crucial for hydration. It helps regulate muscle contractions and nerve signals, ensuring that your muscles respond effectively during exercise. When you sweat, you lose potassium along with sodium, so replenishing it helps prevent muscle cramps and supports optimal performance. Adequate potassium intake can contribute to overall cardiovascular health by helping to maintain healthy blood pressure levels.† Himalayan Rock Salt Himalayan Rock Salt is loaded with essential minerals like magnesium, calcium, and potassium, all of which help with hydration and electrolyte balance. Keeping your muscles hydrated during intense training is crucial for optimal performance and helps to prevent cramps.† Astragin® Astragin® is a powerful ingredient that enhances nutrient absorption, making sure your body gets the most out of every scoop. Derived from natural plants, Astragin® helps your body efficiently absorb essential ingredients like amino acids and vitamins, which means you’ll experience better pumps, more energy, and improved performance during your workouts.
